data.exact_reserve_text:
During 2014 the net loss ratio (net of acquisitions costs) on certain lines of business for the 2012 and prior years of account were increased. These increases are set out in the table below together with their effect on ultimate claims reserves.
Treaty: 6,023
Liability: 16,719
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a strengthening of prior year reserves by GBP 22.742 million in 2014, primarily driven by adverse development in the Treaty and Liability accounts from the 2012 and prior years of account. This was due to worse than expected claims experience and increased net loss ratios in these lines.
raw_causal_phrases: deterioration arises on the 2013 and prior years of account
emanates primarily from the liability account which no longer written in that form
worse than expected claims experienced primarily in the US liability account
further movement in the discontinued element of the Treaty account
the net loss ratio (net of acquisitions costs) on certain lines of business for the 2012 and prior years of account were increased

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure is likely net of reinsurance, as indicated by the narrative 'net loss ratio' in the movement note. No gross figure was explicitly available. 'Liability' LOB in lob_movements mapped to 'Casualty' as per standard Lloyd's LOBs.
